title: CNC-02 Insert T07 Severe Flank Wear
description: Flank wear VB = 0.38 mm (exceeds 0.30 mm UCL). Micro-grooves on carbide relief face.
analysis: Visual metrology confirms severe abrasive flank wear VB = 0.38 mm exceeding 0.30 mm tolerance threshold.

title: Primary Cutting Edge Chipping
description: Localized brittle edge fracture (0.65 mm notch width) along cutting margin due to thermal shock.
analysis: Visual metrology detects localized primary cutting edge chipping with 0.65 mm notch width along margin.

title: Workpiece Surface Chatter Scoring
description: Periodic surface waviness pitch 1.2 mm, vertical chatter stripes from spindle vibration peak at 4.8 mm/s.
analysis: Surface inspection reveals periodic chatter marks and waviness from spindle harmonics.

title: Fresh Insert T07 Within Nominal Tolerance
description: Pristine TiAlN coated cutting edge. VB = 0.04 mm <= 0.30 mm. Sharp radius, no micro-fracture.
analysis: Visual metrology confirms cutting insert within nominal specification. Flank wear VB = 0.04 mm, sharp cutting edge, no defect detected.
